title: Build the explainer page outside the verifier's work tree
summary: `cargo run -p xtask -- site` must not write into the repository work tree. The default output moves to the cargo target directory (`$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/site`, else `target/site`), which Athena already points outside the snapshot. The Pages workflow and docs follow. Audience: the Athena owner, whose explainer jobs were rejected on the blocker "the verifier changed its snapshot".

defaults_applied.how: Remove the write into the work tree at its source (the default output location) instead of weakening the verifier's snapshot check.
Add unit tests in xtask for the default output path and for refusing an --out inside the repository root. cargo test and clippy must pass.
The rule that building the page never writes into the tracked repository tree is enforced in code (the xtask refuses it) and by a test, not only stated in prose.
One focused change to the xtask, the Pages workflow, and the docs that describe them.
A behavior criterion has the verifier run the site build and then check git status.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The failing write was the verifier building the page with the default `site/` or an `--out` path inside its work tree. I could not confirm which path changed the hash, because the verifier's transcripts are not in the snapshot.

The producer should first reproduce the problem. Snapshot::work_tree_tree in crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs honours .gitignore, and /site is already ignored, so the offending path may be something else, such as an explicit --out.

Athena's verifier environment sets CARGO_TARGET_DIR to {job_dir}/target/{side}, outside the snapshot (crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs). Writing the page there leaves the verifier's work tree untouched.
Athena's own snapshot/verify code (crates/athena-core/src/run.rs, snapshot.rs) is not changed. The fix is in the page builder, not in loosening the snapshot-changed check.
The two rejected explainer jobs' content changes (glossary, CHANGELOG notes) are not part of this request.

acceptance_criteria.text: In a verifier-like setting, run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, then `git status --short`. The status output is empty, and index.html exists under the cargo target directory's site/ folder rather than in the repository root.

`cargo test -p xtask` passes. It includes a test that the default output directory is not inside the repository work tree. It also has a test that `--out` pointing inside the repo root, apart from the ignored target directory, is refused with a clear error. The existing build_writes_index_html test still passes.

.github/workflows/pages.yml uploads the new output directory, and its path matches the xtask default (for example `target/site`). The workflow stays a thin call into `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- site`.

docs/design/explainer-site.md and the xtask usage text state where the page is written and why. The reason is that building must not change the verifier's snapshot. The old `/site` location is no longer described as the default.
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] has an entry saying building the explainer page no longer writes into the work tree, so a verifier's snapshot stays unchanged.

out_of_scope: Changing the explainer's content (glossary, claims, CHANGELOG notes from the rejected jobs).
Loosening or changing the verifier's snapshot-changed check in crates/athena-core or crates/athena-git.
departures: Slightly lower acceptance and pass odds than the reference. I could not confirm which path the verifier's build actually wrote, so the producer may have to reproduce the problem and adjust the fix.
